text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh! Help meee~!

While walking along the riverbank,
a small Umamusume sprinted past.

Please wait...!
You girl with the red ribbon over there!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: P-P-P-PLEASE WAIIIIT!!
choice_data_list: Acala the Immovable Wisdom King?! ――Wait, no, Fenomeno?!

text_block_list.text:
His expression is terrifyingly intense. I'm not entirely
sure what happened, but it's clear I need to calm Fenomeno down.
choice_data_list: Wait, wait! Tell me what's going on!

text_block_list.text:
The kid Fenomeno was pursuing seems to be hiding
in the playground equipment, holding their breath.
I step aside to ask what happened.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――Like I said, it's a misunderstanding.
I had zero intention of harming anyone... I even told her there was no need to be scared.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This officer was merely attempting to return a forgotten plushie, that is all.
However, it seems my face was rather intimidating—

It appears that the more serious she gets,
the more terrifying her facial expression becomes.
choice_data_list: ...Ah, then why not use that plushie?

text_block_list.text: She might like animals or puppet shows. I suggested trying to persuade her by pretending to be a plushie instead of speaking as herself.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Uh... S-So you were here! I searched everywhere for you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I got separated from you and was lost! The police officer brought me back!
choice_data_list: Aw, that's wonderful! You got to meet your friend again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
!!
I-It's true... My croquette...!

Timidly, the girl stepped out from inside the playground equipment.
And then――she came face-to-face with Fenomeno,
whom she hadn't been able to see while hiding.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The police officer has a scary face, but he's not a bad guy. Don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I thought it must be precious to you, so I chased after it frantically.
I apologize for scaring you.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girl
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Thank you, and I'm sorry too, Officer.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And with that, case closed!
Trainer, thank you very much for your cooperation!
choice_data_list: I'm glad your feelings got through to her.
That was quite a performance, Officer!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Some people might be frightened by this face...
but my desire to help children is completely genuine!
choice_data_list: Do your best, I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
! In that case, I shall depart on patrol
to maintain public order at once!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
!
This approach seems very useful for helping children feel comfortable around me in the future!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
All right... I'll buy some plushies to take home and practice in my room!
A dog, a cat, a rabbit――
